payload.title: Parse the Biblicus 1.15 failure envelope in BiblicusRunner
payload.description: Biblicus 1.15.0 prints one CommandFailure JSON object on stdout for every typed command failure (exit 2 request rejected, exit 1 operation failure). Parse it in BiblicusRunner, drop the per-method error_stream declarations, update url-text/transform callers and tests, raise the biblicus lower bound to >=1.15.0,<2, and correct the GROBID doc. Follows PPY-c32c35 and Biblicus blbs-fbf385 / blbs-83623f.
